title: Pure Sky Scourge
summary: The Sky Scourge trio—Sky Scourge Norleras, Sky Scourge Enrise, and Sky Scourge Invicil—bridges LIGHT Fairy and DARK Fiend monsters for devastating field wipes and floodgates! Normal Summon Diviner of the Herald (a LIGHT Fairy that dumps Elder Entity N'tss or Trias Hierarchia to load LIGHT Fairies in the GY) alongside Tour Guide From the Underworld (which loads DARK Fiends with Sangan and Scarm!). Once you have 1 LIGHT Fairy + 3 DARK Fiends in your GY, Special Summon Sky Scourge Norleras (or copy Norleras in the GY with Phantom of Chaos!) and pay 1000 LP to send ALL cards on the field and in BOTH hands to the GY, then draw 1 card—or Tribute a LIGHT Fairy (like a revived Trias Hierarchia) for Sky Scourge Invicil to negate all Spell Cards on the field!

allow.Phantom of Chaos: Core Level 4 DARK Fiend combo piece: banishes Sky Scourge Norleras (or Sky Scourge Enrise) from your GY until the End Phase to copy its name, ATK, and effect—allowing you to pay 1000 LP and activate Norleras's total hand-and-field wipe + draw 1 WITHOUT needing 4 monsters in your GY!
allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Level 3 DARK Fiend starter that Special Summons Sangan or Scarm from your Deck—putting 2 DARK Fiends into rotation to link into Muckraker From the Underworld (3 DARK Fiends in GY for Sky Scourge Norleras!).
allow.Sangan: Level 3 DARK Fiend summoned from the Deck by Tour Guide; when linked off into Muckraker From the Underworld, puts 2 DARK Fiends in the GY and searches Phantom of Chaos (0 ATK), Diviner of the Herald (500 ATK), or Herald of Orange Light (300 ATK)!
allow.Scarm, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss: Level 3 DARK Fiend that searches Tour Guide From the Underworld or Sangan during the End Phase of the turn it is sent to the GY, providing a 3rd DARK Fiend in your GY for Sky Scourge Norleras!
allow.Diviner of the Herald: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Tuner that sends Trias Hierarchia (a LIGHT Fairy) or Elder Entity N'tss (a LIGHT Fairy) from your Deck/Extra Deck to the GY—immediately providing the 1–3 LIGHT Fairies in the GY required for Sky Scourge Norleras and Enrise!
allow.Trias Hierarchia: Level 9 LIGHT Fairy (sent from Deck to GY by Diviner of the Herald) that tributes Diviner as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself from the GY—putting 2 LIGHT Fairies in the GY for Norleras/Enrise AND providing a LIGHT Fairy on the field to Tribute Summon Sky Scourge Invicil (which then negates all Spell Cards on the field!)!
allow.Herald of Orange Light: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy handtrap that discards itself and another Fairy (like Sky Scourge Enrise or Invicil!) to negate a monster effect, putting 2 LIGHT Fairies into your GY on Turn 0!
allow.Chaos Space: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards a LIGHT or DARK monster (putting Sky Scourge Norleras directly into the GY for Phantom of Chaos!) to search Sky Scourge Norleras or Sky Scourge Enrise directly from your Deck!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Sky Scourge Norleras directly from your Deck to the GY so Phantom of Chaos can immediately copy it!
allow.Elder Entity N'tss: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Fusion sent from Extra Deck to GY by Diviner of the Herald to destroy 1 card on the field and supply a LIGHT Fairy in your GY for Norleras and Enrise.
allow.Chaos Angel: Level 10 Synchro (summoned using Level 6 Diviner + Level 4 Phantom of Chaos, or Level 6 Sky Scourge Invicil + Level 4) that banishes a card and grants LIGHT + DARK protection.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 DARK Fiend made with Tour Guide + Sangan/Scarm that puts 2–3 DARK Fiends into your GY for Sky Scourge Norleras and revives Phantom of Chaos from your GY!

main: Sky Scourge Norleras

Signature Level 8 DARK Fiend boss (2400 ATK; searchable by Chaos Space!): Must be Special Summoned from your hand by banishing 1 LIGHT Fairy and 3 DARK Fiend monsters from your GY; pays 1000 LP to send ALL cards on the field and in BOTH players' hands to the GY, then YOU draw 1 card!
Sky Scourge Enrise

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Fairy boss (2400 ATK; searchable by Chaos Space!): Must be Special Summoned from your hand by banishing 3 LIGHT Fairy and 1 DARK Fiend monsters from your GY; once per turn targets 1 face-up monster on the field and banishes it!
Sky Scourge Invicil

Signature Level 6 EARTH Fairy floodgate boss (2200 ATK): cannot be Special Summoned; if Tribute Summoned by Tributing a LIGHT Fairy monster (Diviner of the Herald or Trias Hierarchia!), negates the effects of ALL Spell Cards on the field (Imperial Order on legs!); if Tribute Summoned by Tributing a DARK Fiend (Tour Guide, Sangan, or Phantom of Chaos!), negates the effects of ALL Trap Cards on the field (Royal Decree on legs!)!
Phantom of Chaos

Core Level 4 DARK Fiend combo piece (searchable by Sangan!): once per turn targets 1 Effect Monster in your GY (Sky Scourge Norleras!) and banishes it to copy its name, original ATK, and effects until the End Phase—letting you fire Norleras's total field-and-hand wipe for 1000 LP!
Tour Guide From the Underworld

Level 3 DARK Fiend starter: Special Summons Sangan or Scarm from your Deck to Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld—immediately loading 3 DARK Fiends into your GY for Sky Scourge Norleras while Sangan searches Diviner of the Herald (a LIGHT Fairy) or Phantom of Chaos!
Sangan
Level 3 DARK Fiend summoned by Tour Guide; searches Phantom of Chaos or Diviner of the Herald when linked off, completing the 1 LIGHT Fairy + 3 DARK Fiend setup!
Scarm, Malebranche of the Burning Abyss
Level 3 DARK Fiend that searches Tour Guide From the Underworld or Sangan during the End Phase when sent to the GY.
Diviner of the Herald

Core Level 2 LIGHT Fairy starter: sends Trias Hierarchia or Elder Entity N'tss (both LIGHT Fairies!) from your Deck/Extra Deck to the GY on Normal Summon, providing the LIGHT Fairies needed for Enrise, Norleras, and Invicil (plus N'tss destroys a card!)!
Trias Hierarchia
Level 9 LIGHT Fairy dumped by Diviner; tributes Diviner to revive itself, putting 2 LIGHT Fairies in the GY and 1 LIGHT Fairy on the field to Tribute for Sky Scourge Invicil!
Herald of Orange Light
Level 2 LIGHT Fairy handtrap: discards itself and a Fairy (Enrise or Invicil) to negate an opponent's monster effect and put 2 LIGHT Fairies into your GY immediately.
Chaos Space

Limited to 1 in TCG: sends a LIGHT or DARK monster from your hand to the GY (putting Sky Scourge Norleras into the GY for Phantom of Chaos, or putting a LIGHT Fairy/DARK Fiend into the GY!) to add Sky Scourge Norleras or Sky Scourge Enrise directly from your Deck to your hand!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Sky Scourge Norleras directly from your Deck to the GY so Phantom of Chaos can copy it immediately.
extra: Link-2 DARK Fiend: links off Tour Guide + Sangan/Scarm to load DARK Fiends into the GY for Sky Scourge Norleras, and discards 1 card (like Norleras!) to revive Phantom of Chaos from your GY!
Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Fusion sent from the Extra Deck to the GY by Diviner of the Herald to destroy 1 card on the field and supply a LIGHT Fairy in your GY for Norleras and Enrise.
Level 10 Synchro boss (Level 6 Diviner + Level 4 Phantom of Chaos, or Level 6 Invicil + Level 4) that banishes a card on Summon and grants LIGHT + DARK protection.
